title: New Orleans Wings of the Wetlands Guided Birding Expedition
includes: 1 hour and 45 minute guided birding tour by a licensed captain and an experienced bird guide
Map of area explored and bird identification pamphlet
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the hidden marshes of Bayou Bienvenue on a guided birding boat tour that lasts 1 hour and 45 minutes. Led by a licensed captain and an experienced bird guide, this tour offers an exceptional chance to observe various wading and water birds, including iconic species such as great blue herons and roseate spoonbills. As you navigate through tranquil waterways, your guide will share insights on natural history and conservation. Bring your binoculars for prime viewing and receive a complimentary bird guide booklet to track your sightings. Perfect for both novice birders and seasoned enthusiasts.

- Guided birding tour through the scenic Bayou Bienvenue
- Spot iconic Louisiana birds like great blue herons and bald eagles
- Includes water and a souvenir bird guide booklet for tracking sightings
- Accommodates up to 28 guests with restroom facilities available on board
